name: M3U8 Downloader
description: Queue HLS (.m3u8) URLs in bulk with the output filenames you want, and have Jellyfin remux them to MKV one at a time in the background using the server's own ffmpeg. The queue survives restarts and retries failed downloads.
overview: Bulk-download m3u8 streams to MKV files.
